title: Jaggy Chapel, Wallaby Chase, Ark's Injury
summary: From a jaggy desert chapel, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids began a voracious voyage. Muchly hardened, they navigated a landscape of rival devices and airship wrecks. This journey, a jackpot of flights and shimmering mystery, would baffle any inspector. They raced through an urban playground, chased by a translucent wallaby, an envoy of extinction. With a thwack, they avoided the muck, banking away from a gentleman's wasted efforts. In a graveyard, they gravely complimented an ark, its injury incurred by drones, now just chunks of junk. The fugitive, hassled, fumbled with a lock, a heretic's symbol nearby. With intelligence, they identified a new path. The old world implodes, but a new loyalty blooms. Prone on a Jamaican beach, they slowly pluck a mustards flower. A kind merman monitors the cows, the future uncertain yet nice.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Amidst the desert's jaggy sprawl, a glamorous, glowy chapel marked the start of a voracious voyage.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a desolate, jaggy desert landscape at golden hour. A hardened, glamorous chapel, glowing faintly with an internal shimmer, stands precariously on a cliff edge. Below, the wreck of an ancient chevron-winged airship lies half-buried in thick sand. In the foreground, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls examines a collection of muchly arcane devices, a look of baffle on their face. This is the start of a voracious voyage, a jackpot of forgotten technology promising many flights, but also rivals.

scenes.sentence: Through an urban playground, they raced, a translucent wallaby's chase mirroring a gentleman's wasted past.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, in action within a vast, abandoned urban playground. They raced across rusted gantries, banking hard as a massive, translucent wallaby-like creature with hicky patterns on its fur, resembling an envoy, chased them. A gentleman's wasted efforts were evident in the muck and entrails spilled nearby. Above, a small drake flew through an updraft, observing the chaotic scene. The air is cool and desaturated, reflecting the tension as extinction seems imminent. They swiped at the wallaby with a thwack, avoiding its reach. The scene should evoke a sense of urgency, like a barber shop's rapid-fire chatter.

scenes.sentence: Harsh lamps revealed a gravely injured ark, its lock fumbled, surrounded by established junk drones.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, their face illuminated by the harsh rim lighting of distant, flickering lamps. They gravely compliment a series of established junk drones, their metallic segments looking like munchkin chunks. Slime drips from a nearby ark, which has incurred a serious injury. Their fingers fumble with a complex lock, while a heretic's symbol is visible on a fragment of metal nearby. The drones, like knifes, hover menacingly, having nibbled at the surrounding graveyard. The teenager is hassled, aware of the fugitive status.

scenes.sentence: The old world implodes, but new loyalty emerges, a kind merman watching over slow, growing peace.
scenes.prompt: Overhead shot of a serene Jamaican landscape at dawn, bathed in soft, diffused light. Below, the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls is prone on a beach, slowly plucking a singular, glowing mustards flower. Their intelligence monitors indicate that the old world implodes, but loyalty remains. Nearby, a herd of cows grazes peacefully, observed by a kind merman. Whiskey bottles litter the sand, remnants of a bygone decade. The future is uncertain, but a nice new lock, freshly identified, offers a kinder path. There is no nudity.
